title: Protospace validation suite: machine-checked algebra for emergent Dirac/Weyl matter, geometry, and induced gravity
description: Executable verification harness backing the protospace programme manuscript "The protospace programme: from a discrete analogue to a substrate whose slow-gradient limit yields induced 3+1 general relativity." Pairs each algebraic, combinatorial, and structural claim with a test in sympy (exact symbolic identities), z3 (finite SMT), or numpy/scipy (finite numerical diagnostics). Covers the matter algebra (Clifford, Lorentz, Dirac/Weyl, chirality), graph-local chiral balance, emergent-geometry diagnostics (spectral dimension, cone criterion, low-mode metric, U(1) holonomy), and the deepened gravity layer (torsion-free spin connection solved on general 2D and 4D FRW tetrads, the signed Lichnerowicz coefficient with a general-Riemann certificate and the spinor curvature commutator derived from the suite's own Lorentz generators, the Seeley-DeWitt a_1 coefficient derived spectrally on the round S^2, proper-time integrals deriving the cutoff scalings, and the Sakharov-Volovik induced-gravity skeleton with per-scheme sign certificates). v0.4.1 adds the causal, symmetry, and numerical rungs: the causal order generated by the substrate determines the emergent metric (executable Malament/Hawking-King-McCarthy plus causal-set volume counting, Myrheim-Meyer dimension, local recovery of a position-dependent light cone), the full Poincare algebra emerges with its lattice breaking entering first at dimension six when parity protects it (with the excluded dimension-five class as negative control), and the emergent curvature is reconstructed numerically from metric data by finite differences and Regge deficit angles, through dimension four on the FRW family. The causal-order reconstruction runs on the quantum walk's own event order (bracketing returns the strict lattice cone as an output, Alexandrov-interval counting the Lorentzian proper time), the induced-gravity sign mechanism is given as sign(sigma)*sign(xi_eff-1/6) over real field content, the Euclidean/Lorentzian seam of the effective action is certified, and the geometry falsifier is established over ensembles of 800 and 1800 graph instances with disjoint diagnostic ranges and margins that widen with system size. Reports 469 passing checks.
